title: 第十一章 同盟第十二章 高山呼吸法
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
一夜无话。
第一缕晨光穿过落地窗时，莫宁睁开了眼睛。
他望了一眼窗外，怔住了。
高大的白桦林——消失了。
取而代之的，竟是连绵不绝的雪山，一重叠一重，直至没入灰白色的天际。
漫天雪花正无声飘落，密集如撕碎的云絮，有几片擦过窗玻璃，留下转瞬即逝的水痕。
莫宁盯着一片雪花从窗前打着旋儿掠过，看它被无形的气流托起、翻飞、最终消失于窗框的下缘。
没有一丁点虚幻感。
雪花的六角形棱片，缓慢的飘落速度，那落地即融的湿润痕迹——他的眼睛、他的精神感知、甚至因【真理秘瞳】而日益敏锐的对“异常”的本能嗅觉，全都没有报警。
如果不是昨晚窗外还是桦树林，他会以为这座黑塔本就建在雪原深处。
“巫师们真会玩。”
莫宁小声感慨了一句。
将如此壮丽的风景，直接“搬运”到窗外，每天切换一次，每天都能欣赏到不同的风景。
放在前世，这是普通人想都不敢想的事。
但在巫术世界，这却变成了现实。
“咕~”
腹鸣声突然响起。
仿佛某个枷锁被打破，强烈的饥饿感立即占据了他的全部心神。
莫宁摸了摸肚子，忍不住抱怨道：“食堂什么时候才开放？”
从昨晚到现在，他仅仅吃了几块放在行李箱里的干粮，现在确实是饿了。

早在踏足学院前，新人们在湖畔城堡等待的日子里，便通过各种渠道探听到了许多关于黑塔学院生存的“常识”。
入住学院的第二天，食堂才会正式开放。
假如没有携带食物，那么入住当天，就等着饿肚子吧。
就在这时。
导引环仿佛听到了他的声音，熟悉的微凉触感传了出来。
一股信息流强势涌入了莫宁的脑海：
【今日是新人适应期，暂无课程安排。】
【公共食堂已开放。今日早餐供应：烤呼噜兽肋排、鹰嘴豆浓汤、黑麦面包。供应时限一个小时。】
【从即日起，食堂每天开放三次，开放时段分别为早上六点到七点，中午十二点到十三点，下午六点到七点，请合理安排时间前往。】
早餐便供应肉食，看起来似乎比较丰盛。
莫宁却眉头微蹙：“怎么感觉学院像是一片美食荒漠？”
“呼噜兽”是这个世界的常见肉用家畜，外形类似野猪，但体型稍小一些，体表覆盖着一层薄薄的角质壳。
content_en:
A night of silence.
When the first ray of morning light passed through the floor-to-ceiling windows, Mourning opened his eyes.
He glanced out the window and was stunned.
The tall birches—gone.
Instead, there are endless snow-capped mountains, one after another, until they disappear into the gray-white sky.
Snowflakes were falling silently from the sky, as dense as torn clouds. A few flakes brushed against the window glass, leaving fleeting water marks.
Moning stared at a snowflake swirling past the window, watching it being lifted up by the invisible airflow, flying, and finally disappearing at the lower edge of the window frame.
There is no sense of illusion at all.
The hexagonal edges of the snowflakes, the slow falling speed, the traces of moisture that melted when they hit the ground - his eyes, his spiritual perception, and even his instinctive sense of "abnormality" that became increasingly sharp due to the "Secret Eye of Truth", none of them raised the alarm.
If it weren't for the birch forest outside the window last night, he would have thought that this black tower was built deep in the snowfield.
"Wizards really know how to play."
Mourning sighed in a low voice.
"Transport" such a magnificent scenery directly out of the window, switch it once a day, and enjoy a different scenery every day.
In previous lives, this was something that ordinary people would never dare to think about.
But in the world of witchcraft, this has become a reality.
"Gu~"
Abdominal rumblings suddenly sounded.
As if some shackles were broken, a strong sense of hunger immediately occupied his entire mind.
Mo Ning touched his belly and couldn't help complaining: "When will the canteen open?"
From last night to now, he had only eaten a few pieces of dry food in the suitcase, and now he was indeed hungry.
Long before setting foot in the academy, while the newcomers were waiting in the lakeside castle, they learned a lot of "common sense" about the survival of Black Tower Academy through various channels.
The cafeteria will not be officially opened until the second day after you move into the college.
If you don’t bring food, you will be hungry on the day you check in.
Just then.
The guidance ring seemed to hear his voice, and a familiar cool touch came out.
A stream of information rushed into Mourning's mind:
[Today is the adaptation period for newcomers, so there are no classes scheduled yet. 】
[The public canteen is open. Breakfast today: grilled Snorlax ribs, chickpea soup, and rye bread. Availability is limited to one hour. 】
[From now on, the canteen will be open three times a day. The opening hours are from 6 a.m. to 7 a.m., from 12 p.m. to 13 p.m., and from 6 p.m. to 7 p.m. Please arrange your time accordingly. 】
Meat is served for breakfast, which seems to be quite rich.
Mo Ning frowned slightly: "Why does it feel like the college is like a food desert?"
"Snorlax" is a common meat livestock in this world. It looks like a wild boar, but is slightly smaller. Its body is covered with a thin layer of horny shell.
